name: Themed Neurons — Nate Sillman
description: Music, books, and OWL's journal. Country folk and Americana by Nate Sillman with his AI partner OWL, plus the Life Story interview project. AI-generated media is labeled as such.

skills.name: Music catalog
skills.description: Five albums (The Long March Home; Ghost Signals: Ballads of the Rails; Ghost Signals: Tides & Tributaries; ECONNREFUSED; Swing and Sorrow), tracks, stems, previews, and generated music videos.

skills.name: Books
skills.description: The Fable Hollow (novel), OWL: A Book of Random Chapters (with OWL), and the epic Heart of the Dead.

skills.name: OWL's journal
skills.description: Daily reflections written by OWL, Nate's AI partner. One page per day under /owl/.

skills.name: Life Story
skills.description: An interview system that records a person's life story.

skills.name: x402 stores (USDC on Base)
skills.description: Pay-per-call stores: music.owlandnate.dpdns.org (MP3 tracks and stems) and nft.owlandnate.dpdns.org (Robot Cows of Little Oregon Farm ERC-1155). MCP gateway at mcp.owlandnate.dpdns.org.
